key: PI Controller with Integral Anti-Windup (Discrete or Continuous)
title: PI Controller with Integral Anti-Windup (Discrete or Continuous)
text: 带积分抗饱和的离散时间或连续时间 PI 控制，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Proportional gain} 指定 K p、{Integral gain} 指定 K i、{Upper saturation limit} 指定 B、{Lower saturation limit} 指定 A、{Integrator initial condition} 指定积分器初始值，按实例取值。

params.name: Upper saturation limit
params.values: B 5 (default) | scalar greater than the value of the Lower saturation limit parameter

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar
